digest.component_or_area: Pandoc verification and corpus testing infrastructure
propositions: Complete real-Pandoc corpus replay is performed on every Gerrit Verify cell and contributes a measured 184.32-second macOS lower bound that should be removed from the per-change hot path.
Committed deterministic Pandoc outputs must cover every corpus input and settling pass, enabling broad assertions to use static fixtures instead of live subprocess invocation.

Routine Gerrit Verify must retain all corpus assertion classes, all supported Python/OS cells, and sample representative live product-path bodies from each stratum (code_arrow, table, prose) with version and platform probes.
A dedicated external integration job must perform complete real-Pandoc full-replay validation on ubuntu-latest and macos-latest on a weekly schedule and via workflow_dispatch.
Static fixture generation and validation must be deterministic, support non-writing verification, and fail-closed on provenance or platform fingerprint mismatches.
